Every Department of Buildings job that touched the number of homes

Lots, land use, owners, year built and homes today: the Department of City Planning's PLUTO file. Homes added and removed: the Department of City Planning's Housing Database, version 26Q2.1, which lists 3,029 Department of Buildings jobs in Community Board 6. Added and removed count completed jobs only. 38 lots have no outline on file and are listed in search but not drawn. 30 jobs are on lots that no longer exist in the tax map and are drawn as dots. Sales: the Department of Finance's annualized sales, 2016 through 2025, 11,233 sales of $10,000 or more; transfers under $10,000 are left out, and 278 sales could not be matched to a current lot. Historic district boundaries and permit records: the Landmarks Preservation Commission.
